provenance.source: JPL Horizons fixed 2026-09-03 epoch. Uses the paper’s J2000-equatorial satellite-orbit pole RA 20.8° ±1.9°, Dec 34.9° ±1.9° as a body-pole prior under the explicit equatorial-orbit assumption. Arbitrary prime meridian and rotational phase.
provenance.qualification: Computed Huya Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
